finding.text: The Dictation word "mic" (Server/ai2-overview.mjs:46) is matched as a plain substring, so it hits "michael/dev", which appears in many merge-step requests. 2026-09-24/layout-names and 2026-09-06/docs-after-size land in Dictation for that reason alone, and so does 2026-09-22/system-retro. Match whole words (a `\b…\b` regex per word), or drop "mic" and keep "microphone".

Substring matching has the same risk for the other short words: "apps" and "panels" in any prose request, and "page.js" (line 34), which almost every build brief mentions. That pulls unrelated work into Page, the second-ranked concept (131 done). Match words against the slug and group first, and fall back to the request text only when those find nothing. The request is the noisiest of the three.

findOwnerQuote (line 116) also accepts `head.includes(prompt.slice(0,40))`, so a very short owner prompt matches any request that contains it. Today there is one: "popups". Require the prompt to be at least ~20 characters before testing that direction.

The quote is the matched prompt's first 120 characters, not the part that matched. For a long dictated prompt, that can be a preamble that says nothing about this task. It is acceptable for now, but worth a look in the UI.
groups.json and cards.jsonl are not read, so words_url is always the task page. The brief allowed this ("if they help").

doc/overview.md is 30 lines against the ten asked for, and it is not yet listed in ai2/page.js's `notes:`. The task log flags the second point for the UI minion, so /framework/ai2/doc/overview/ 404s until that is done.
View and App show $0 cost across 114 done tasks. That is probably real (older tasks predate cost_usd), but the UI should show "—" rather than "$0" so it doesn't read as free.

Everything else matches the brief: the shape, the concept order and icons, open limited to 7 days with stale_count, done capped at 30 newest with done_count, the counts logged, and all seven concept URLs exist on disk.
